summary: Specifies the DDoS Open Threat Signaling (DOTS) signal channel, a protocol a client uses to ask a mitigation server for protection against DDoS attacks. It is designed to work even under attack conditions. It was replaced by RFC 9132.

eli5.summary: When a flood of unwanted visitors arrives, you press an alarm button to call for help. This is that button for networks.

questions: what is the dots signal channel
how do clients request ddos mitigation
